scope: One agent-driven local graphical controls run, using ordinary desktop keyboard input. This is not a reusable harness, latency or rewind qualification.

host.desktop: Coordinator cloud computer; not the Mac Studio

game.edition: Police Quest I EGA 2.0G, DOS AGI 2.917

input.path: DotBox default desktop service; supported bound native-window ordinary keyboard input
input.status_cli_limitation: The separate command-execution namespace could not read the desktop service temporary token file. No credentials were copied and no claim of a CLI lease observation is made.

observed_sequence.evidence: Native title and lobby rendered; Return advanced the original game
Ordinary arrows crossed the lobby doorway; room overview rendered
Walked around locker bank and opened assigned locker through command entry
Submitted remove clothes once, closed locker, and visibly returned in the towel outfit
Walked around the shower collision barrier using a west/north/east approach, with fresh observations and stop inputs
After final ordinary rightward adjustment, the game acknowledged shower activation and visibly rendered water
Submitted turn off shower and observed removal of the water effect

preparation_and_measurement.budget_note: The first recorded live observation occurred after the declared budget; actual game-ready time was not instrumented. Retained preparation time is unknown. This exploratory run is not a latency pass.
preparation_and_measurement.measurement_limit: Tool execution times and partial event notes do not supply a complete movement, turn or player-visible delay trace.

observed_findings: Arrow input latched movement; repeating the same direction stopped motion in an unchanged room. Transitions and modal conversations require a new observation.
KP_5 entered the digit 5 with this desktop mapping; it was removed with BackSpace and was not treated as a working stop control.
NPC conversations interrupted the route and were dismissed before resuming.
A direct northward approach met a collision barrier; the static picture supported a western approach followed by eastward movement.
Head-pixel estimates were insufficient at the narrow interaction boundary. Final acceptance relied on the original game response and visible effect, without claiming measured live coordinates.

read_only_source_corroboration.scope: Asset and static branch verification; no live variable, flag or coordinate address mapping was measured.

evidence_boundary.live_basis: Fresh native-window screenshots observed during the conversation and recorded ordinary input actions
evidence_boundary.public_contents: Authored outcome, structural findings and hashes only; no game assets, scripts, messages, saves, screenshots, session tokens or raw memory
